feedback: No reviewer point was proven by a failing reproduction, so none blocks; they are listed above as open notes.
unproven: Missing implementation for several required UI features and content, causing many requirement IDs to be unfulfilled: - R13‑R14 (serif headings and sans-serif body) rely on CSS variables, but the global stylesheet sets only the body font to var(--font-sans) and headings to var(--font-serif). However, the header wordmark uses a class that defaults to navy color but never applies the serif font to headings inside the content sections; the CSS may not enforce serif headings everywhere, potentially failing the test for R13. Verify that all heading elements (h1‑h6) across all pages use the serif font. - R15‑R16 (hero h1 display size) rely on CSS variables `--text-display` and media queries; the current CSS sets `h1` font-size to `var(--text-h1)`, not `--text-display`. The hero h1 is styled via `.hero h1` which uses `var(--text-display)`. But the test checks the computed font-size on the h1 element, which may be affected by CSS cascade and not reflect the expected pixel range on different viewports. Ensure the hero h1 size matches 56‑64 px on desktop and 36‑40 px on phones. - R18‑R19 (soft shadows and hover lift on cards) are applied via `.card` styles, but the pillar cards use `.pillar-card` without the shadow or hover transform. The test expects all cards (including pillar cards) to have soft shadows and lift on hover. - R20‑R21 (section fade/slide‑in animations) are implemented via `.fade-in` class and `@keyframes fade-up`, but many sections (e.g., credibility strip, who‑we‑serve panels, case‑study cards, testimonial block) do not have the `fade-in` class applied. The tests verify the presence of the `fade-in` class on each major section. - R22‑R23 (WCAG AA contrast) are checked by the theme test using the contrastRatio function. The current theme tokens pass contrast for text on white and navy, but the text overlay on photos uses a navy gradient overlay defined as `linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(11,31,58,.94), rgba(11,31,58,.88) 58%, rgba(11,31,58,.45))`. This gradient may not provide sufficient contrast for white heading text on the hero photo (requires a minimum contrast of 4.5:1). The test for contrast only checks token colors, not overlay contrast, so it currently passes, but the specification requires WCAG AA contrast for text over photos. Add a darker overlay or adjust text color to meet contrast. - R25‑R30 (photo img attributes) are implemented in `src/components/Photo.tsx`, but the home hero uses a custom `` directly in the hero component (not via Photo component) and may be missing required attributes (`srcset`, `sizes`, `width`, `height`, `loading="eager"`). Ensure the hero uses the Photo component or replicates its required attributes. - R32 (nav gradient overlay on text over photos) requires a navy gradient behind any text on a photo. The hero overlay uses a gradient, but other sections where text overlays photos (e.g., Who we serve panels) use a plain `` without overlay, violating R32. Add a gradient overlay in those sections. - R34‑R36 (line icons for services, training formats, engagement tiers) require each item to have an inline‑SVG line icon. open_notes:
Incorrect aria aria-label for footer navigation column: The footer nav column for 'Company' is expected to have aria-label="Footer" and contain a heading link 'Company' label per test, but src/content/site.ts defines only NAV_LINKS and not a separate 'Company' column; the footer rendering does not include a heading for the column and the test 'Company column' fails because it looks for a title with text 'Company' (the test uses within(footer).getAllByText('Company')[0]). The current implementation uses the generic Footer component without a column header, causing the test to not find the expected element. Fix: Add a column heading element with text 'Company' (e.g.,

Company

) inside the footer navigation for the company links and ensure aria-label is set appropriately.

Missing placeholder tag and note text for case study cards: The test expects each case-study card to contain a visible "Placeholder" tag and the note text defined by CASE_STUDY_NOTE, but the rendered case-study cards in HomePage do not include these elements. The content constants exist but the component does not render the placeholder tags/notes, causing tests for case study placeholders to fail. Fix: Update HomePage to render a visible element with class 'placeholder-tag' containing "Placeholder" and a paragraph or note element with the CASE_STUDY_NOTE text for each case study card.

Missing placeholder tag and note for testimonial block: The test expects the testimonial block on navy to include a placeholder tag and note text, but the current implementation of the testimonial block does not render these. Add a visible "Placeholder" tag and the note from TESTIMONIAL.note in the testimonial block.

Missing implementation of the new Engagements page: the content module src/content/engagements.ts and its various fields (ENGAGEMENTS_INTRO, ENGAGEMENT_TIERS, etc.) are not present in the code base, causing requirements R93-R130 to be unmet.
The home page does not include the credibility strip overlay gradient and the bell‑curve motif background as required by R49 and R38; the overlay is a solid navy gradient only.

Photos are rendered using a component that always includes a sizes attribute, but the attribute value `(min-width:1024px) 50vw, 100vw` does not match the required sizes for responsive images (e.g., 768w and 1344w) as per R25‑R27; also the hero photo lacks loading="eager" and priority handling may be incorrect.
The header nav links in src/content/site.ts were not updated to include the "Engagements" link, violating requirement R41.
The footer column for Services does not list the "Engagements" link, violating requirement R42.
The Contact page does not render the optional "Company size" select field after the Company input, as required by R163‑R165.
The engagement tier cards are missing the required premium styling (dark navy, teal outline, larger size) and the enterprise‑atrium photo, breaking R121‑R122.
The hero h1 does not use the display size range specified (56‑64px desktop, 36‑40px mobile) because the CSS variables and media queries set different values, failing R15‑R16.
The "Read more" links in the pillar cards are incorrectly styled as text links with an ArrowIcon, not matching the required button styles (R71).
The site lacks a reduced‑motion media query that disables all animations, hover lifts, and scroll transitions under prefers‑reduced‑motion, failing requirement R21.
